basin_support.meaning: Analysis cells per basin on the 15 arc-second grid. A value from a basin with few cells is supported by few observations; every row carries its own valid and expected counts so this can be filtered on. A basin with no cell at all would yield no value rather than a zero.

span_note: Years accumulate across runs; each year names the run that produced it. wall_seconds and retries describe the most recent run only. Years marked reconstructed were counted back from the observation store after an earlier ledger was overwritten.
